claims: An assertion satisfies a requirement exactly when it has at least one row of the named fact type and every such row's value is admissible, and the first failing requirement gives the declared reason for the offending value, else its id.

The packaged call with no new argument writes the same four outputs as before, and the default rules passed explicitly give the same reasons in the same order, with policy-refused where the /1 record has fail for a supported statement.

Every bad rules document, rule naming an unknown or non-attached fact type or role, and out-of-range max_targets refuses with a value-free Refusal before the judgment route runs, and publishes nothing.
Every /2 record binds the shape and rules by digest and records max_targets and max_rows, so changing any one changes the record.

Every regular expression, string split, slice and special-case branch this change adds handles the whole class of input it is given, not only the examples in the tests and fixtures, and none reads structured text that a parser or an existing reader in this repository already reads.
